newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-REAL MAINTAIN LEAD AS BARCELONA RETAKE SECOND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REAL MAINTAIN LEAD AS BARCELONA RETAKE SECOND.

text.p: Barcelona regained second place in the Spanish first division on goal difference from Real Betis on Sunday with an emphatic 4-0 victory over struggling Sevilla.
But Real Madrid maintained their nine-point lead over both sides thanks to two first half goals by Fernando Hierro in a straightforward 2-0 home win over Zaragoza.
Fourth-placed Deportivo Coruna were a further three points back after struggling to beat Racing Santander 2-1, with a fine performance by striker Renaldo.
Barcelona needed to win by two goals to retake second place after Betis defeated Oviedo 4-0 on Saturday.
Ronaldo, Juan Pizzi, Luis Enrique Martinez and Oscar Garcia found the target.
